newsitem.title: USA: Banco Bilbao to buy into Argentinian bank.
newsitem.headline: Banco Bilbao to buy into Argentinian bank.

text.p: Argentina's Banco Frances del Rio de la Plata SA has reached an agreement to sell 30 percent of its capital stock to Spain's Banco Bilbao Vizcaya SA.

Banco Frances said in a statement sent from Buenos Aires late on Monday that the Argentinian and Spanish central banks and other regulatory agencies would have to approve the transaction before it could come into effect.
Officials from the two banks were not immediately available for comment.
"Both parties have announced their intention of maintaining the current strategy followed by Banco Frances...to reach an important position in the Argentine financial system," it said.
Banco Frances said part of the selling group would become shareholders in Banco Bilbao.
It did not give further details about the deal.
